fields.reference: The job reference shown in the first column
fields.status: Where the job is: scheduled, dispatched, on-site, blocked or complete
fields.priority: How urgent the job is: low, normal or high
fields.customerName: The customer the job is for
fields.technician: The technician assigned to the job
fields.slaHoursRemaining: Hours left against the service level; negative means overdue
fields.openedYear: The year the job was opened
fields.warrantyStatus: Warranty status of the job; not in the data today

live.columnOrder: The order of the columns in the worklist
live.labels: The heading shown over each column
live.displayRules: Which rows are styled, such as overdue jobs
live.placeholderColumns: Columns the data does not carry yet, marked and shown with an illustrative example value (or a dash when there is none)

recordedOnly.defaultSort: The starting sort of the worklist; recorded with your pin, but the table does not sort yet
recordedOnly.defaultFilter: A starting filter on the worklist; recorded with your pin, but the table does not filter yet
